gcp.secretmanager.access.note: Access operations per 10,000. The first 10,000 a month are free, counted over the billing account ("Monthly free usage limits are aggregated across projects by billing account", https://cloud.google.com/secret-manager/pricing). One SKU for every location, with the free operations as a $0 first tier; it is not listed under "global", so sync reads it in us-central1.

gcp.secretmanager.versions.note: Active secret version per location; automatic replication counts as one location. The catalog prices a version-month ($0.06), 730 version-hours. Six active versions a month are free, counted over the billing account ("Active secret versions | 6 versions"; "Monthly free usage limits are aggregated across projects by billing account", https://cloud.google.com/secret-manager/pricing): the SKU lists them as a $0 first tier of 6 version-months, row 4380 (6 × 730 version-hours).
